Container.Name: Trackhop
Container.Overview:
BETA. Trackhop keeps your playlists in sync between music services (Spotify, YouTube Music, TIDAL, Navidrome, Jellyfin, Plex, Last.fm and more), one way or both ways, on a schedule, from a web page on your server. The same engine as the Trackhop Android app and Desktop. Guide: https://trackhop.org/guide/docker
Set a password if anyone else can reach the port. SONGPORT_URL is the address you open Trackhop at: service sign-ins come back to it.
Container.DonateText: Trackhop is free; a coffee keeps it going.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Syncs, settings and sign-ins. Back this folder up and you have backed up Trackhop.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Asked on every page (any user name will do). Set it whenever anyone else can reach the port.

Config.Name: Address
Config.Description: The address you open Trackhop at, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080. Service sign-ins come back to it.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Texts from the engine: it, de, fr, es, pt-BR, pl, ru, tr, zh, ja, ko. Empty: English.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the data folder and runs Trackhop (99: nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the data folder (100: users).
